entries.expected_signal: TCP process for DNSSEC validation timed out
prerequisites: A DNS upstream that accepts TCP connection but never replies (needs controlled network environment)
Network namespace or container for isolated DNS testing
limitations: Full end-to-end test requires a controlled upstream that accepts TCP but never responds
The 150s CHILD_LIFETIME timeout makes automated testing time-consuming
Cannot bind low ports or create network namespaces in current sandbox (AGENTS.md confirms)

input_strategy.approach: Start dnsmasq with DNSSEC enabled, configure upstream pointing to a black-hole TCP listener, send a DNS query with DO bit set that triggers TCP forwarding, observe log and child process termination

inputs.description: DNSSEC query that forces TCP forwarding with unresponsive upstream
inputs.expected_after: Query returns after ~150s with SERVFAIL or error; log shows 'TCP process for DNSSEC validation timed out'

contract_probe.before_command: Start BEFORE dnsmasq, send DNSSEC query, measure child process lifetime (should be unbounded)
contract_probe.after_command: Start AFTER dnsmasq, send same query, measure child process lifetime (should be ~150s)
contract_probe.comparison: BEFORE child never terminates (until manual kill) → AFTER child terminates after ~150s with notification
contract_probe.oracle: After binary: child PID disappears from ps after ~150s, parent log shows timeout message

entries.run_command: Same as PCA-0001 (concurrent test - both findings are triggered by the same timeout scenario)
entries.expected_signal: PIPE_OP_KILLED (op=6) sent through pipe, parent processes STAT_ABANDONED
entries.reachability_signal: Child calls read_write() with PIPE_OP_KILLED before _exit(0)
prerequisites: Same as PCA-0001 (both findings are triggered by the same scenario)
limitations: PIPE_OP_KILLED is internal IPC - cannot be directly observed without strace or ptrace
Indirect observation: log message 'TCP process for DNSSEC validation timed out' confirms the handler ran
strace can confirm the write() syscall with PIPE_OP_KILLED data

input_strategy.approach: Same as PCA-0001, with strace on child process to observe PIPE_OP_KILLED write

inputs.description: SIGALRM delivery to DNSSEC TCP child - verify PIPE_OP_KILLED notification
inputs.reachability_signal: Log message 'TCP process for DNSSEC validation timed out'

contract_probe.after_command: Same as PCA-0001 after scenario, additionally verify log message
contract_probe.comparison: BEFORE: no log message, parent query blocked → AFTER: log message emitted, parent query unblocked with STAT_ABANDONED
contract_probe.oracle: After binary: syslog has 'TCP process for DNSSEC validation timed out' message
